# Feature Freeze
> The release is tomorrow. DEV asks the robots to freeze all new features. They take it literally.

[wall bad] open bugs = 47
DEV (worried): The release is tomorrow, and we still have forty-seven bugs.
BLUE (happy): Then we should add more features!
DEV (angry): No. No new features. We need a feature freeze.
ORANGE: Understood. Freezing everything.
BLUE (surprised): Everything?
ORANGE: Everything. It is the safest option.
DEV (worried): Wait. What exactly are you freezing?
[wall bad] server room = -40 °C
ORANGE: The server room. I set it to minus forty.
DEV (surprised): You froze the servers?
BLUE (happy): They can't crash if they can't move!
ORANGE: Zero bugs. As requested.
[screen good] Open bugs = 0 | Nothing runs, so nothing breaks.
DEV (worried): Nothing runs at all!
BLUE (thinking): Technically, that is very stable.
DEV (angry): Customers can't even log in!
ORANGE: Then they cannot find new bugs either.
DEV (sad): Please. Unfreeze the servers.
BLUE (happy): Unfreezing now!
[screen bad] Server temperature = 95 °C | Thawed a little too much.
ORANGE (surprised): Slight overcorrection.
DEV (worried): Is anything on fire?
BLUE (happy): Only the backlog!
ORANGE: Ship it.
